notes: Tied token embedding and output head are counted once.
Each DDP rank holds full parameters, gradients and Adam first/second moments: 16 bytes per parameter; do not divide by world size.
Base storage excludes activations, temporary buffers, gradient buckets and allocator/NCCL overhead.
The simulator uses one gradient bucket and no computation/communication overlap.
The measured NCCL collective does not force Ring; simulated Ring and measured NCCL algorithm must not be conflated.
